attaches.why: Explains why the fifteen-minute overlap call fell short: it covered the open cases but not those that arrived during the hand-off week. It bears on how the intake rota hand-off runs, which the existing frame reads cleanly.

position_revisions.why: The frame holds, but the overlap call at each hand-off is now thirty minutes, not the fifteen Priya stated, so that expression's duration is no longer correct. src-1 keeps the fortnightly cadence agreed on 1 October and sets the longer overlap. The pantry restocking and start-date members are untouched.
